# Hyperlink samples

A bare URL: https://example.com/docs?view=compact&lang=en

A URL with paired parentheses: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Text_editor_(program)

Markdown delimiters should stay outside the link: *https://example.com/italic* and **https://example.com/bold**.

Nested paths may contain punctuation: https://user@example.com:8080/a_b/c-d?q=one#result

Trailing punctuation should stay outside: https://example.com/finished.
